title: Average American Rates Their Home 7.5 Out of 10
paragraphs: If you had to give your home a rating out of 10, what would you give it?
The average American says they would give their home a rating of 7.5.

That's what Talker Research found when it asked 2,000 American homeowners to rate their homes in June. It also found that the average American homeowner has a house of about 175 square meters, with three bedrooms and two bathrooms.

Asked how they feel about their home, many said good things, with 42% saying they feel "happy" with their home, and 33% saying they feel "good." Only 11% said their feelings about their home are "complicated."

For people who are happy with their home, 36% say it's because of how big it is, and 30% say it's because they love the backyard. Many also say they like their living room and how big their kitchen is.
But 20% of homeowners say they are thinking of moving out of their house — many because they don't have the money to pay for it, or because their home needs too many repairs.
When asked what they would miss about their home if they moved out, 33% said it would be the memories, and 27% said it would be the house itself.
Forty-three percent of homeowners say they often think about living in a different house. But 46% say they are trying to make the house they have now into their dream home.
